sloka: ताम् शुक्लक्षौमसम्वीताम् व्रतयोगेन कर्शिताम् ।तर्पयन्तीम् ददर्शाद्भिः देवताम् देववर्णिनीम् ॥२-२०-१९॥
transliteration: tām śuklakṣaumasamvītām vratayogena karśitām ।tarpayantīm dadarśādbhiḥ devatām devavarṇinīm ॥2-20-19॥

translations.english: Kausalya, emaciated due to observance of vows and clad in white silk looked like a celestial being. She was engaged in offering libations to the deities.
